ssr.css: .reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__zoom{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;text-align:center}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__zoom-image{width:100%;height:auto;max-height:85vh;object-fit:contain;border-radius:12px;transition:opacity .3s ease}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__zoom-arrow{position:absolute;top:50%;z-index:1;transform:translateY(-50%);padding:10px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;font-size:40px;cursor:pointer;color:#555;opacity:.7;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__zoom-arrow--previous{left:20px}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__zoom-arrow--next{right:20px}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__zoom-minify{position:absolute;top:20px;right:20px;z-index:1;padding:6px 12px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:#000;color:#fff;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;opacity:.8}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__zoom-arrow:hover,.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__zoom-minify:hover{opacity:1}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__zoom-arrow:focus-visible,.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__zoom-minify:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #555;outline-offset:2px}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__slider{padding:20px;text-align:center;position:relative}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__slider-main-image{width:100%;height:auto;max-height:75vh;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 2px 12px #00000014;transition:opacity .3s ease;object-fit:contain}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__slider-thumbnails{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:20px}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__slider-thumbnail{padding:0;border:2px solid #e0e0e0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;opacity:.7;transition:opacity .2s ease,transform .2s ease}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__slider-thumbnail img{display:block;width:140px;height:140px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:6px}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__slider-thumbnail--active{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.02);border-color:#555}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__slider-arrow{position:absolute;top:50%;z-index:1;transform:translateY(-50%);padding:10px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;font-size:40px;cursor:pointer;color:#555;opacity:.7;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__slider-arrow--previous{left:20px}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__slider-arrow--next{right:20px}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__tile-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--gallery-max-columns),minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__tile{display:block;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:transparent;box-shadow:0 2px 12px #00000014;cursor:pointer;opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);transition:opacity .4s ease,transform .2s ease}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__tile:hover{transform:scale(1.02)}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__tile:focus-visible{outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:2px}.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__tile-image{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}@media(max-width:600px){.reactedge-productgallery .product-gallery__tile-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.reactedge-productgallery .standard-widget-loader-wrapper{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;min-height:200px}
